lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Seven years the Midianites ruled. Each harvest, raiders swept the land like locusts.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Gideon beat wheat in a winepress, hidden from the raiders. A man of the least family, in the smallest clan.

lines.speaker: angel
lines.text: The Lord is with you, mighty warrior.

lines.speaker: gideon
lines.text: If the Lord is with us, why has all this happened? Where are His wonders?

lines.speaker: angel
lines.text: Go in the strength you have. I am sending you to break Midian's yoke.

lines.speaker: gideon
lines.text: How can I save Israel? My clan is the weakest, and I am the least in my father's house.

lines.speaker: angel
lines.text: I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The call does not turn on a hero's strength. It turns on the presence of the Lord with the unlikely.

choices.label: Answer the call
choices.note: The story keeps its shape; Gideon carries the promise forward.

choices.label: Rest in the winepress
choices.note: A pause does not change the outcome. It only lets the player breathe.
